device.basis: X-T3 5.11 viewfinder output setup, run when VIEW MODE selects the viewfinder: it read-modify-writes +0x004, writes table words to +0x008..+0x014, then writes 0 to +0x000 and waits for bit 0 to read 1; its release sets +0x004 bits 0x1f0fff again. Other words read back their last write; what the words select is not modeled. The viewfinder picture itself is scanned by the rear screen controller at 0xfffa9000, retimed to 1280 columns.
